svg.title: Player anchors and the collision mask
svg.desc: The real player sprite frame with its four anchor points: the camera point at the chest, and at the feet the interaction point, two collision probes, and the sort line. Beside it, the boat deck next to its collision mask, where black blocks, white is open deck, red marks the storage door and green marks the bow.
svg.text: Anchors are authored in frame pixels, then scaled with the player (0.45 in game).
two feet that test the mask
THE DECK AND ITS MASK · boatscene/
black blocks · white is open deck · colors are named regions
